description: Implementation of ProxyConfigService and platform-specific factory function for creating system proxy configuration services in Chromium project.

classes.name: UnsetProxyConfigService
classes.description: A ProxyConfigService implementation that always returns CONFIG_UNSET, used for ChromeOS.

classes.name: ProxyConfigServiceDirect
classes.description: A ProxyConfigService implementation that always returns direct proxy configuration.

methods.name: AddObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer to the proxy config service (no-op in implementations).

methods.name: RemoveObserver
methods.description: Removes an observer from the proxy config service (no-op in implementations).

methods.name: GetLatestProxyConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the latest proxy configuration; either unset or direct.

methods.name: CreateSystemProxyConfigService
methods.description: Factory method to create platform-specific system proxy config service.

methods.name: UsesPolling
methods.description: Indicates whether the proxy config service uses polling; returns false.
